Opened housing on the pole with the TinyML chip glowing. The lamp turns amber at 24.6 s, the risk bar fills to three segments, and the 'Judged on the station' tag appears at 24.8 s.
Risk bar at four segments. Cut at 25.4 s to a wide shot of the station pole in deep brown floodwater, a dark server building at left and the downtown skyline behind.
Dashed line from the station housing toward the 'Central server' building stops short with break marks. Skyline visible. Deep floodwater fills the lower half.
Cut at 27.2 s to a bungalow street flooded to the doorsteps, station at left and hub at the street end. Rings start at the antenna at 27.6 to 27.8 s.
Yellow rings travel down the flooded street toward the far end, shrinking with distance.
Rings reach the street end. A scale line and the 'More than a half-mile' tag pin at 29.2 to 29.8 s, and the hub lamp lights.
Static hold of the street with the half-mile tag and scale line. The caption clears at 30.8 s.
Cut at 31.2 s to an open grass field with the Hub building, mast and fence, and no skyline. A 'Station' inset at upper left emits the first arc.
Rings expand from the station inset across the sky. The 'Up to five miles in open country' tag appears at 32.8 s.
Rings reach the mast, whose tip lights at 33.2 s, and the hub window lights. No skyline in the open-country frame.
Hold with the mast and hub window lit and the tag pinned. The caption clears at 34.8 s.
Field hold, then a cut at 35.4 s to the hub room. A seated responder faces a 'Flood path map' monitor showing a creek line and street grid.
'A second, larger model' tag pins. Dots light along the creek. The responder's arm reaches the keyboard; the hands look like blobby claws.
The responder's head turns toward the map at 37.2 s. Otherwise a static desk scene with tags.
Push to the full-frame map at 38.2 s. Orange paths spread along the creek and branch streets at 38.6 to 38.8 s. The lower 40 percent of the frame is blank beige.
Paths complete. 'Higher risk' dashed zones and the 'For emergency responders' tag appear at 39.6 to 39.8 s.
Static map with the lower frame blank beige. The caption clears at 40.4 s.
Cork notice board on posts at a curb with an empty-bar 'Validation accuracy' card. Flooded street in the foreground.
Static board until a bar-fill marker appears at 42.6 to 42.8 s.
98.82% appears and the orange bar fills by 43.4 to 43.6 s on the notice-board card.
Static board showing 98.82%. The caption clears at 44.6 s.
Push-in crop from 45.4 s cuts the card's left edge. The figure reads 98.82%, then 8.82%, and the disclosure overlaps the title.
Card cropped to '8.82%'. The 'itial assessments / ter training' tag, clipped at the left edge, pins at 46.4 to 46.8 s.
Static hold of the clipped '8.82%' card and the clipped assessments tag over the flooded curb.
Blank 'Field result' card slides in from the right at 48.2 s. The validation card is still clipped.
Pull-back at 49.2 s shows both full cards (98.82%, initial assessments after training, Field result), then a pan right crops the validation card.
A forearm from the top edge presses a stamp onto the Field result card, leaving 'None reported' at 50.4 to 50.6 s, then lifts.
The stamped 'None reported' card holds. The validation card is clipped to '2%' at the left edge.
Cut at 52.2 s to a chain-link fence with the downtown skyline. A paper map with a creek line appears pinned to the fence at 52.8 s.
A forearm from the right slides a finger along the map's creek at 53.2 to 53.6 s and lifts toward the upper map at 53.8 s.
The hand leaves at 54.2 s. The 'Announcement names no installation' tag pins at the top right of the map at 54.4 to 54.6 s.
Map hold, then a cut at 55.6 s to a curb folding table: a technician holding a Deployment plan, a closed carry case and a prototype station on a stand, with a flooded street in the foreground.
The technician folds the plan and tucks it into the carry case pocket at 56.0 to 56.8 s. The hands look like blobby claws.
The latch is pressed and the 'Deployment goal' tag pins at 57.2 s. Hands rest at the case and the caption clears at 57.4 s.
Static settle: the case stays on the table with the technician standing behind. No lift or carry, and floodwater remains in the foreground.
Closing hold to 59.2 s, then a cut at 59.4 s to the Texas AI Docket credits card with the sources line.
Static credits card with the flag, Texas AI Docket wordmark, URL and UT San Antonio Today source.
Static credits card, unchanged, with the illustration and map editorial lines.
Static credits card, unchanged, with texasaidocket.com and the sources block.
Static credits card, unchanged, through 63.8 s.
Credits card holds unchanged to the final frame at 64.367 s.
